candidates.description: The tokens represent the lowercase letter 'y' in various forms, capitalizations, and sub-word tokenization contexts.
The feature vector activates strongly on the letter 'ä' and words or subwords containing this character, particularly in Germanic or Nordic language contexts.
These tokens represent common German prefix morphemes and root words frequently found in compound nouns and adjectives.
This feature vector activates on common personal pronouns and coordinating conjunctions frequently used as sentence subjects or objects.
This feature vector represents quantifying adjectives, indefinite pronouns, and nominal suffixes common in German quantity and variety expressions.
These tokens represent third-person German pronouns and determiners inflected for various cases, genders, and numbers.
This vector represents German and Germanic third- and first-person personal pronouns and reflexive markers.
This feature detects the letter sequence "io" or the word root "ion" across various words and languages.
This feature vector activates on common prefixes and root fragments shared across multiple European languages.
This vector activates for academic, scientific, and operational prefixes or abbreviations.
